description: This file contains an abstract test class for verifying multiple grain directory implementations within an Orleans test cluster. It includes test methods for pinging grains across silos, managing cluster silos, and retrieving grain instances based on placement hints.

classes.name: MultipleGrainDirectoriesTests
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing multiple grain directory implementations across cluster silos in Orleans.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster builder, setting initial silo count.

methods.name: PingGrain
methods.description: Test that pings grains across silos and verifies proper communication and silo shutdown handling.

methods.name: GetGrainOnPrimary
methods.description: Retrieves a grain instance on the primary silo based on its runtime instance ID.

methods.name: GetGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Retrieves a grain instance on a secondary silo based on its runtime instance ID.
